text: At its meeting on March 30, 2026, the CreateTO - Human Resources Committee considered Item RD2.1 and made recommendations to Board of Directors, CreateTO.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Approved the confidential recommendation from the CreateTO Human Resources Committee, attached to the letter (March 30, 2026) from the CreateTO Human Resources Committee. 2. Directed that the confidential recommendation, attached to the letter (March 30, 2026) from the CreateTO Human Resources Committee, remain confidential in its entirety as it relates to personal information of an identifiable individual, including a municipal or local board employee 3.
